name: Olenna Tyrell
life: Semi-retired accountant, plans to fully retire at 65 and live off dividends. Reads annual reports for fun.
aesthetic: Traditional; wants an income view (monthly dividends, yield on cost). Finds price charts beside the point.
strategy: Monthly $1,500 into a dividend sleeve: SCHD, VIG, Realty Income, Coca-Cola, P&G, J&J — topping up whatever is underweight. Takes dividends as cash (no reinvesting) and logs every payout from her Edward Jones statement into the app, to the cent.
goals: see how much income her portfolio pays per month/year
know if she can retire at 65
typicalQuestions: How much will I get in dividends this year?
Can I live off this at 65?
How much did I receive last quarter?
Did any of my companies raise their dividend this year?
